scope: Keyboard dock-resize arrows now follow the grouped panel track, so the active panel always resizes toward or away from the canvas correctly even when its group is on the opposite side.

source_control.runtime_message: fix(editor): resize grouped panels toward canvas
source_control.push: Normal fast-forward push verified by git ls-remote; GitHub compare reports 1 ahead and 0 behind with only index.html, shell.js and the browser regression changed.

implementation.root_cause: setupResizers selected the increasing arrow from the panel identity (left/right), while tabbed groups can occupy either physical grid track. For a left panel grouped on the right, ArrowLeft incorrectly decreased its width, moving its edge away from the canvas; the reciprocal right-panel-on-left case was also reversed.
implementation.fix: For desktop tabbed groups, the key handler now derives the active track from workspacePanelMode and panelSide. ArrowLeft/ArrowRight then change width according to the actual dock track and RTL direction. The non-grouped desktop behavior and mobile single-drawer layout remain unchanged.
implementation.regression: The browser test first reproduced the bug: after activating the left panel in the right-side group, ArrowLeft left the width at 294px instead of increasing it to 326px. It also covers the right panel grouped on the left, expected 368px width, correct placement on each side of the canvas, a minimum 400px unobscured canvas, persistence, workspace Undo/Redo, no Page Model writes, and no Save/Publish calls.
implementation.reuse_and_license: Adapted the repository's existing first-party keyboard splitter, tabbed-group, layout and workspace-history contracts. No third-party code or runtime dependency was needed for this direction-selection correction.
